name: v0.4.1
body:
## Changes

### Fixes
- Fix builds_cache UNIQUE constraint to support both x64 and arm64 architectures
- Add CHECK constraints on installed_versions and downloads status columns
- Add foreign key constraint on installed_versions.download_id
- Fix search_builds deduplication to include architecture triplet
- Fix check_for_new_builds to distinguish x64/arm64 per backend
- Add architecture field to favorite_builds for consistency
- Fix silent error swallowing in toggle_favorite_build and migrations
- Replace hardcoded SQLite autoindex name with dynamic pragma_index_list lookup

### Performance
- Replace database polling loop with oneshot channel for download completion
- Add targeted get_version_by_id query instead of full table load
- Add idx_downloads_status index for faster status queries

### Refactoring
- Move launch_config SQL operations to repo.rs (repository pattern)
- Factorize migration helpers (table_exists, column_exists, table_sql)
- Standardize download status naming across the codebase
- Use parameterized SQL in cleanup_old_downloads instead of string formatting

### Chores
- Add versioned migration framework with schema_migrations tracking table
- Add automatic cleanup of old downloads (30-day retention) on startup
- Add download_id column to installed_versions for traceability
